title: Cold store door 2 — pedestrian exits into the dispatch aisle
description: Synthetic held-out scenario. A pedestrian leaves the cold store through door 2 and walks south across the dispatch aisle. The cold-store wall limits the driver's view to the door opening, and a rolling cage parked beside the door blocks part of that opening. The aisle floor is frosty near the door, so braking is weaker.

incident.location: Dispatch aisle at cold store door 2
incident.summary: Reach truck FL-03 stopped for an operative stepping out of cold store door 2.
incident.narrative: Shortly after 06:15 an operative left the cold store through door 2 and walked straight across the dispatch aisle toward dispatch lane 3. Reach truck FL-03 was travelling east along the aisle. A rolling cage was parked against the wall just west of the door. The driver braked as soon as the operative appeared; the truck stopped close to the operative, estimated at about 0.4 m. The floor by the door was frosty.
